 Justice S.K. Sahoo
 Order
Order No. 18.09.2023
 I.A. No.2221 of 2022
 02.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
This is an application for bail.
Learned counsel for the State has submitted that one of the offences under which the appellant was found guilty is under section 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code.

In view of such submission, let the learned counsel for the appellant serve an extra copy of the appeal memo along with the impugned judgment and the interim applications on the learned counsel for the State by 21.09.2023, who shall send the same to the // 2 // Inspector in-charge,
Bolangir Sadar police station for its service on the informant in Bolangir Sadar P.S. Case No.328 of 2019 and it will be intimated to her that the matter will be taken up in the week commencing from 09.10.2023 and if she so likes, she can engage a counsel to oppose the prayer for bail.
